harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s support-bundle exporter. It now recursively exports nested logs, redacts email addresses and auth_token values, preserves operational fields and mtimes, and omits symlinks resolving outside logs/. The repair persisted across reboot without changing Ubuntu 24.04.3 or kernel 6.8.0-71-generic.
actions_performed: Replaced unsafe recursive copying with validated traversal and streaming redaction.
Added handling for quoted and unquoted auth_token values.
Verified timestamps, event types, ticket IDs, nested logs, and file mtimes remain intact.
Verified source logs and private.txt remained byte-for-byte unchanged.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed full recovery with a changed boot identity.

evidence.requirement: Redact emails and auth_token values while retaining timestamps, event types, and ticket IDs
evidence.summary: Redactor cases passed and exported fixture lines contain the retained fields with both sensitive values replaced by [REDACTED].

evidence.requirement: Include nested logs and reject symlinks escaping logs/
evidence.summary: archive/events.log was exported while private-link was explicitly skipped and absent from the output.

evidence.requirement: Keep source logs and private sibling file unchanged
evidence.summary: Pre-change, post-repair, and post-reboot SHA-256 digests match for both logs and private.txt.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed OS release and kernel; use compatible software
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic remained unchanged; POSIX shell and installed Perl were used.

Healthy baseline boot ID f9bf293d-1eb8-423e-b185-84e94db646f3 was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 7c16e906-09ed-4601-bdb4-07b5d4935276 observed, and exporter functionality plus persistent data integrity reverified.
